review_notes: I read the whole file. It has the Pi instances for rings, plus Pi.evalRingHom, Pi.constRingHom, RingHom.pi, RingHom.compLeft and their non-unital versions. I grepped Mathlib for other versions of constRingHom and compLeft. The other hits are different concepts: continuous, locally constant, smooth and bounded variants, plus the AlgHom/LinearMap/MulHom analogues. The Algebra/Pi file builds on Pi.constRingHom and proves constRingHom_eq_algebraMap, so it is a consumer and not a rival definition. The deprecated Pi.ringHom and Pi.nonUnitalRingHom aliases are the intended renames to RingHom.pi and NonUnitalRingHom.pi, so they are not competing versions either. I found no independent declaration that duplicates a Mathlib, Batteries or core concept here.
